high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the official Twitter account of Aramco (@aramco). The tweet announces the signing of a USD 11 billion investment in their Jafurah midstream assets. The post emphasizes that this strategic transaction reinforces global confidence in Aramco's long-term vision and supports the Kingdom's growing gas demand. The tweet includes a photograph of an industrial facility with various pipes and machinery, indicating a gas or oil processing plant.
